authority_basis: plans/PLAN_forex_ng7.md §4 F1(iii): fail-closed re-pull contract frozen BEFORE the pull; byte-identity or honest divergence disclosure; divergence => archive vintage declared THE cycle authority, never silently merged

scope.entitlement: owner TD entitlement (V8/V9/NG5 precedent; F2), key TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY from environment only

comparison_basis.sample: the archive vintage's NEWEST 60 staged bars per leg (the staged member files are THE pinned authority)
comparison_basis.identity_definition: field-level strict string equality on (datetime, open, high, low, close) for every datetime present in BOTH the vendor payload and the staged newest-60 sample; no numeric coercion; values compared as archived strings
comparison_basis.rationale: the vendor serves bars NEWER than the archive vintage tail (archive newest 2026-09-10/12 vs retrieval 2026-09-16), so identity is asserted on the OVERLAP; overlap below 55 of 60 => NOT_RUN_INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP, no conclusion either way

outcomes.BYTE_IDENTITY: every overlapping row field-identical and overlap >= 55 => re-pull PASS; archive vintage remains authority
outcomes.DIVERGENCE: any overlapping row differs (or schema/meta mismatch) => archive vintage is DECLARED THE cycle authority; divergence recorded verbatim (field, staged value, vendor value); vendor bytes NEVER merged into staged data
outcomes.NOT_RUN_KEY_ABSENT: TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY not in environment => record, archive remains authority
outcomes.NOT_RUN_NETWORK: request failure => redacted error only (key value scrubbed, URL never stored beyond scheme+host+path), archive remains authority
outcomes.NOT_RUN_INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP: overlap < 55 => no conclusion; archive remains authority

secrets_law: key value NEVER echoed, logged, or written to any artifact; all error text scrubbed of the key value before recording
no_merge_law: under NO outcome are vendor bytes written into data_raw/forex_ng7_spot/ or any staged file
redaction: artifacts store endpoint path (no query string), HTTP status class, exception type, redacted message <= 300 chars
